title: Epistemic Materialism (Fork theta): bounded material compliance chi from Sector D spectrum
hypothesis: A material is a FILTER FOR TRUTH, not a shader. Compliance chi in [chi_min,1] is a CONTINUOUS map (not a lookup table) of the Sector D covariance spectrum: chi = clip(w*eta + (1-w)*(1-gap)) where eta is the normalized spectral entropy and gap=1-lambda2/lambda1. Ordered/anisotropic covariance (low eta, high gap) -> chi->chi_min (stiff 'diamond', fragile: rejects tiny shear); disordered/isotropic (high eta, low gap) -> chi->1 (compliant 'water', survives high Wi). eps_ref_eff = STRAIN_STAR_REF * chi <= STRAIN_STAR_REF, so a declared material can only NARROW the constitutional window, never widen it. The firewall reports chi_required: the minimum compliance to survive the present shear (the informational phase-change target).
